messages:
Sam: Quick sync — OrionX QBR Wed 10am PT. Need final token econ + spend forecast and confirm budget alerts. TL;DR: customer saw a 3x spike in embeddings in the last 7d. Can ops + enablement help triage? <https://app.redwood.com/accounts/orionx/usage|OrionX dashboard>
Priya: Got it. I'll pull per-route token burn and per-model breakdown. Any thresholds you want for alerts?
Mateo: FWIW the spike looks embeddings-heavy on `search_autocomplete`. Suggest short-term: enable prefix caching, reduce batch size from 16->8 for latency-sensitive calls, and pin smaller quantized embedder for high-volume traffic.
Elena: Risk flag — they're on monthly credits and currently at ~68% of the month. If trend continues they will hit budget before renewal. Recommend alerts at 75% and 90% plus a one-click top-up option. :warning:
Sam: Good call. Can someone update the QBR deck with the new forecast? I left a placeholder slide under /sales/qbrs/orionx — please replace with numbers and the mitigation plan.
Priya: SQL I'm running to get the 7d snapshot: `SELECT route, model, SUM(tokens) AS tokens FROM usage WHERE account='orionx' AND ts >= now()-interval '7 days' GROUP BY route, model;` Will paste outputs here in a bit.
Mateo: I'll draft an enablement checklist for OrionX devs: caching keys, client-side batching suggestions, model pinning, and a minimal example for async retry. ETA EOD Tue.
Elena: Action items (quick): Priya -> numbers + update deck; Mateo -> enablement doc + 15-min office hours slot; Sam -> QBR runbook + renewal note to AE. @CS-bot can you create a reminder channel for preflight?
CS-bot: Reminder created: #orionx-qbr-preflight scheduled Tue 09:00 PT.
Sam: Also let's add a line in the deck about a spend guardrail option (Dedicated capacity proposal) if they want predictable monthly spend.
Priya: Pasted numbers from the query: embeddings tokens (7d) = 1,240,000 (+220% vs prior week), gen tokens (7d) = 312,000 (+30%). If current trend holds, projected monthly burn = ~5.2M tokens (~2.6x current monthly allowance).
Priya: Suggested mitigations to include in the deck: 1) set alerts at 75% / 90%, 2) enable prefix caching for autocomplete, 3) opt-in temporary throttle if %minute-burn > baseline, 4) propose Dedicated monthly commit for predictability.
Elena: I'll draft the AE email with the numbers and request for runway confirmation. cc finance + solutions architect.
Sam: Perfect. If anyone hits blockers or needs API keys/access, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
Mateo: One more note — devs asked for a sample cache key pattern. I'll add this to the enablement doc: `cache_key = sha256(route + '|' + user_lang + '|' + input_prefix)`
Elena: Great. Closing loop: we'll present mitigations in the QBR, offer a short enablement session, and recommend guardrail options. Thanks team.
Sam: Thanks all — will consolidate into the deck and share a final link by Tue morning.
